facts.business: PCBL Chemical Limited is a diversified specialty chemical platform with participation across specialty chemicals, advanced materials, and sustainable solutions, including carbon black, aquapharm chemicals, and battery chemicals through subsidiaries.
key_risks: Foreign currency risk from international operations and transactions in USD, EUR, CNY, KRW, GBP, VND
Liquidity risk in meeting financial obligations
Credit risk from trade receivables and financial assets
Impairment risk on receivables overdue beyond 365 days
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
